authority: User requested removing SportsMOT from continuing evaluation because tracking may include background spectators outside player-only annotations.

SportsMOT.reason: Player-only GT does not cover every person emitted by a generic person tracker; unannotated spectators and true player-to-spectator association errors cannot be separated by missing GT alone.
SportsMOT.existing_results: Retain with original frozen criteria and descriptive annotation limits.
SportsMOT.future_use: Optional separate analysis only for an explicitly defined player-tracking question.

historical_rules: Do not edit frozen runners, selections, registrations, score events or verdicts. Any analysis using the new scope is separately labeled and never retroactively upgrades a previous FAIL or NO_CONSISTENT_SUPPORT.
scope_limits: Dataset exclusion is a task/annotation alignment decision, not evidence that all previous false positives were spectators or that all observed tracking errors were annotation errors.
